note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000 (gameplay classifications). Iceland has no standing army and no conscription, so conscription is classed as a volunteer force. The Evangelical Lutheran Church is the constitutionally supported national church, classed as official_religion with full religious freedom. Electricity and heating come overwhelmingly from hydro and geothermal sources, classed as a green transition. Iceland is in the European Economic Area, so trade is free trade. Immigration and healthcare classifications are gameplay judgements.
